title: 第6章 降临第7章 废物东西
lines: 紫族长老们个个状若疯魔，完全是以命搏命的打法！
他们死死地将君家长老们缠住，绝不让他们靠近祭坛半步！
鲜血，已经开始在神光中飞溅，有紫袍染血，也有灰甲破碎！
怒吼声、惨叫声、神力爆炸声混杂在一起，构成了一曲悲壮而血腥的战歌！
祭坛顶端，那团包裹着紫阳神的生命光霞，在外部毁灭性能量的冲击下，剧烈地波动着，凝聚的速度明显受到了干扰！
紫幽冥在激战中眼角余光瞥见，心都在滴血！
然而，祸不单行！
就在长老级战场陷入惨烈胶着之时，另一股令人心悸的锋芒，从君家大军后方悄然升起！
那是一群年轻的身影。
人数不多，仅有十余人，但每一个都如同出鞘的神剑，锋芒毕露！
他们穿着统一的君家核心弟子银白战衣，气息强横，最弱的竟也达到了祖神境中期，为首的数人更是深不可测！
而在这群耀眼天骄的最前方，一道身影，却显得格外不同。
他一身纤尘不染的月白长衫，没有任何华丽的装饰，却仿佛将漫天星辉都披在了身上。
身姿挺拔，面容俊秀得近乎完美，如同最上等的神玉雕琢而成。
周身笼罩着一层淡淡的、仿佛与天地本源相合的朦胧仙辉，让他看起来神秘而超然，仿佛不属于这喧嚣的战场，而是九天之上俯瞰众生的神只。
他仅仅是站在那里，就自然而然地成为了绝对的焦点。
身后那些在各自星域都足以称霸一方、桀骜不驯的君家顶尖天骄们，此刻竟都微微低着头颅，姿态恭敬，眼神中充满了敬畏与狂热，如同在朝拜他们的王！
白衣男子神情淡漠，目光平静地扫过前方惨烈的长老战场，最终，落在了那百丈祭坛顶端，那团剧烈波动、却依旧顽强搏动着的生命光霞之上。
此人，赫然正是君家年轻一代第一人，神子……君逍遥！
他的眼神，没有君天命那种赤裸裸的杀意，只有一种近乎天道般无情的……漠视。
仿佛毁灭一个种族最后的希望，对他而言，只是拂去一粒微尘。
他并未开口，只是随意地抬起了右手，对着祭坛的方向，轻轻一指。
“遵神子令！”
“毁掉祭坛！
断绝紫族希望！”
其身后那十余位早已蓄势待发的君家顶尖天骄，如同得到了神谕，瞬间爆发出惊天动地的杀气！
十余道璀璨的神光冲天而起，化作撕裂虚空的毁灭洪流，目标直指百丈祭坛！
他们要绕过长老战场，直接摧毁核心！
“休想！
“保护祭坛！
保护少家主！
早已严阵以待的紫阳仙，发出一声清越的娇叱！
content_en:
The elders of the Purple Clan all look like crazy demons, and they are completely fighting for their lives!
They tightly entangled the rulers and elders and would not let them get even half a step closer to the altar!
Blood has begun to splash in the divine light. Some purple robes are stained with blood, and some gray armor is broken!
Roars, screams, and divine explosions mixed together to form a tragic and bloody war song!
At the top of the altar, the glow of life enveloping the Purple Sun God fluctuated violently under the impact of external destructive energy, and the speed of condensation was obviously disturbed!
Zi Youming caught a glimpse from the corner of his eye during the fierce battle, and his heart was bleeding!
However, misfortune never comes singly!
Just when the elder-level battlefield was in a fierce stalemate, another heart-stopping edge quietly rose from behind the Jun family's army!
It was a group of young figures.
There are not many people, only about ten people, but each one of them is like an unsheathed divine sword, with its sharp edge revealed!
They were wearing the uniform silver-white battle clothes of the core disciples of the Jun family, and their auras were powerful. The weakest of them had actually reached the middle stage of the Ancestral God Realm, and the leaders of them were even more unfathomable!
But at the front of this group of dazzling geniuses, a figure looked particularly different.
He was dressed in a spotless moon-white gown without any gorgeous decorations, but it seemed as if the stars in the sky were draped over him.
The figure is tall and straight, and the face is almost perfect, as if carved from the finest divine jade.
His whole body was covered with a faint hazy fairy glow that seemed to be consistent with the origin of heaven and earth, making him look mysterious and aloof, as if he did not belong to this noisy battlefield, but a god overlooking all living beings in the nine heavens.
Just standing there, he naturally became the absolute focus.
Behind them, the unruly and unruly top geniuses of the Jun family, who were able to dominate their respective star regions, lowered their heads slightly at this moment, with respectful postures, and their eyes were full of awe and fanaticism, as if they were worshiping their king!
The man in white had an indifferent expression, and his eyes calmly swept across the tragic battlefield of elders in front of him. Finally, he landed on the top of the hundred-foot altar, on the violently fluctuating but still tenaciously pulsing glow of life.
This person is surprisingly the number one member of the younger generation of the Jun family, the Son of God... Jun Xiaoyao!
There was no naked murderous intention in his eyes like Jun Tianming's, only a kind of ruthless... indifference that was almost like the way of heaven.
It was as if the last hope of destroying a race was just a speck of dust to him.
He did not speak, but casually raised his right hand and pointed lightly in the direction of the altar.
"Follow the orders of the Son of God!"
"Destroy the altar!
Cut off the hope of the Purple Clan! "
Behind him, the dozen or so top talents of the Jun family who were ready to attack seemed to have received an oracle, and instantly burst out with earth-shattering murderous intent!
More than a dozen dazzling divine lights soared into the sky, turning into a torrent of destruction that tore through the void, aiming directly at the Baizhang Altar!
They want to bypass the elder battlefield and destroy the core directly!
"Don't even think about it!
! "
“Protect the altar!
Protect the young master!
! "
Ziyangxian, who had been waiting for a long time, let out a clear and charming cry!
